mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, type, source_id, target_id
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ref_tree AS ( SELECT source_id, target_id, 1 AS depth FROM so_b2c_ref WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND is_deleted = false UNION ALL SELECT r.source_id, r.target_id, rt.depth + 1 FROM so_b2c_ref r INNER JOIN ref_tree rt ON r.source_id = rt.target_id WHERE r.is_deleted = false ) SELECT DISTINCT target_id FROM ref_tree WHERE target_id NOT IN ( SELECT source_id FROM so_b2c_ref WHERE is_deleted = false )
